js: (async()=>{const g=__gm;g.setTime(11);await g.spawnHero();g.teleport(360,-330);g.cam.yaw=g.cam.tYaw=3.1;g.sim(20);await new Promise(q=>setTimeout(q,3500));g.sim(3);g.step(1);const vis=o=>{for(let p=o;p;p=p.parent)if(!p.visible)return false;return true;};let figs=0,figMeshes=0,other=0,sh=0;const c=g.combat();c.monsters.forEach(m=>{if(m.fig&&m.fig.obj.visible){figs++;m.fig.obj.traverse(o=>{if((o.isMesh||o.isSprite)&&vis(o)){figMeshes++;if(o.castShadow)sh++;}});}});g.scene.traverse(o=>{if(o.isMesh&&vis(o))other++;});return {figs,figMeshes,sh,other,lights:g.scene.children.length}})()
